subject: Re: FastLedger demo — scheduling across DST gap
messages:
From: Tim Sanders <tim.sanders@fastledger.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma@fastledger.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Redwood demo — preferred 8:00 AM PT on Mar 16?

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick responses last week. We’re aiming to lock a live demo with your team for the week of Mar 15. Our product folks prefer 8:00 AM PT on Tuesday, Mar 16 (that works best for our engineering lead). Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood would present?

A couple quick notes:
- We’re distributed across US time zones; 8:00 AM PT is the easiest anchor for our East/West participants.
- Europe is heading toward the end of March DST change and we know that sometimes causes mismatches. If it helps, we can be flexible by 30-60 minutes.

Attached is a short list of the features we care most about (auth/data isolation, batching, rollout controls). Looking forward.

Thanks,
Tim
Tim Sanders
Director of Integrations, FastLedger

Attachments: FastLedger-demo-request.pdf (pdf, 92 KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tim Sanders <tim.sanders@fastledger.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 17:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood demo — preferred 8:00 AM PT on Mar 16?

Hi Tim,

Really appreciate the clear ask and the agenda. Quick note up front: Mar 16 falls in the window after US DST (Mar 14) but before EU DST (Mar 28) this year, which means a 1-hour offset oddity for some of our EU hosts if we translate strictly by wall clock. Wed like to avoid last-minute clock confusion.

Options that will keep things simple from our side:
1) Keep 8:00 AM PT (we can match that); that maps to 17:00 CET for our Berlin-based presenters on Mar 16.
2) Move 30 minutes later (8:30 AM PT / 17:30 CET) to provide a little buffer for EU travel or overlap.
3) If you prefer an earlier EU-friendly time, we can host at 09:00 CET (00:00 PT) but that pushes our US team into overnight, so we generally avoid that.

Operationally we suggest: Jordan host the demo, Marcus handle the infra deep dive (KV cache and batching), and Ill open with the product narrative and coordinate the recording. If you confirm 8:00 or 8:30 AM PT I will send a calendar invite with the call link + a short run-of-show.

We have a fallback plan: if daylight saving confusion causes a mismatch, we will keep the demo and provide the recording within 2 business hours and schedule a 30-minute follow-up with your engineers (hosted by Marcus) at a mutually convenient time.

Proposed ephemeral agenda (attached):
- 5m intro
- 20m product walkthrough (Irene)
- 20m infra & performance deep dive (Marcus)
- 10m Q&A / next steps (Jordan)

Would either 8:00 AM PT or 8:30 AM PT on Tue Mar 16 work for you?

Best,
Irene Choi
Partnerships & Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: FastLedger-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Tim Sanders <tim.sanders@fastledger.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 18:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood demo — scheduling across DST gap

On Thu, 11 Mar 2027 at 17:30 +0100, Irene Choi wrote:
> Options that will keep things simple from our side:
> 1) Keep 8:00 AM PT (we can match that); that maps to 17:00 CET for our Berlin-based presenters on Mar 16.
> 2) Move 30 minutes later (8:30 AM PT / 17:30 CET) ...

Echoing Irene: 8:00 AM PT -> 17:00 CET is fine for our Berlin team. To minimize risk from the DST window I suggest:
- We set the invite in UTC on the event (reduces client-side calendar reinterpretation).
- I will add a line in the invite: "Time shown is local to your calendar client. Redwoods will join at 17:00 CET / 08:00 PT (Mar 16)."
- Marcus will be on standby to join 15 minutes early for any connectivity checks.

Also +1 on recording and quick follow-up slot. If FastLedger wants, we can also provide a short tokenized runbook after the call that maps Redwood API calls to your integration steps.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tim Sanders <tim.sanders@fastledger.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma@fastledger.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood demo — scheduling across DST gap

Hi Irene / Jordan,

Thanks for the clear options and the DST callout  that was helpful. We’re happy to keep 8:00 AM PT on Tue Mar 16 (17:00 CET). Please send the invite in UTC as Jordan suggested and include the recording option. Marcus joining early for a connectivity check is perfect.

One request: can you attach the recording and the short runbook to the calendar event for our internal review? If anything shifts because of calendar client quirks we’ll accept the recording + follow-up slot.

See you then,
Tim
Director of Integrations, FastLedger
